items.fact: Penalties or filtering with a systematically wrong monitor fail to prevent reward hacking
items.quote: using the monitor for data filtering or to apply a reward penalty fails
page: a penalty teaches the model to hide

items.fact: GRAFT routes flagged samples' gradients to a sacrificial set of new parameters
items.quote: GRAFT constrains gradient updates on those samples to a sacrificial set of new parameters

items.fact: The monitor is not part of the reward
items.quote: because the monitor is not part of the reward function

items.fact: Ablating the sacrificial parameters reduces or stops the behaviour
items.quote: ablating the sacrificial parameters reduces or entirely stops the unintended behavior

items.quote: training models ranging from 135M to 8B parameters

items.fact: Setting: misspecified reward, weak monitor with a conditional blind spot, hacking as default, objective
